title: 橋梁動態荷重試驗
subcategoryTitle: 橋梁耐久、檢測與健康監測
subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge durability, inspection and health monitoring
summary: 從車輛動力效應與人群同步振動出發，說明試驗載重與預期反應的計算、儀器與取樣率、趟次矩陣與封橋安全、強迫振動與人群試驗、動力放大與頻率判讀、以試驗修正係數更新評等，以及舒適度改善與基準交接，並以倫敦千禧橋的人群試驗與阻尼改造、雪梨港灣大橋 1932 年的機車載重試驗與 1940 年塔科馬海峽橋為對照。
summaryEn: Starting from vehicle dynamic effects and crowd lock-in, explain how to compute test loads and expected responses, choose instruments and sampling rates, plan run matrices and safe closures, run forced-vibration and crowd tests, interpret amplification and frequency, update load ratings with test adjustment factors, and handle comfort retrofits and baseline handover, drawing on the crowd tests and damper retrofit of London's Millennium Bridge, the 1932 locomotive load test of Sydney Harbour Bridge and the 1940 Tacoma Narrows Bridge.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「車輛動力效應與衝擊係數」與「人群誘發振動與同步效應」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Vehicle dynamic effects and impact allowance" and "Crowd-induced vibration and lock-in": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 車輛動力效應與衝擊係數：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Vehicle dynamic effects and impact allowance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「動力放大係數」如何影響橋梁動態荷重試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dynamic amplification factor” governs force, deformation or durability in “Dynamic bridge load testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 車輛以速度通過橋梁時，橋面不平整、伸縮縫高差與車輛懸吊的彈跳，會使橋梁反應高於同一部車緩慢通過時的靜態反應。設計規範以固定的動力載重容許值涵蓋這個效應，AASHTO 對設計車輛的靜態活載效應增加 33%；TRB 的橋梁載重試驗入門指出這個值常偏保守，主要受引道不平與伸縮縫控制。動態荷重試驗的第一個目的，就是用同一部試驗車在慢速與不同車速下的反應比值，量出這座橋實際的動力放大。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「動力放大係數」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When a vehicle crosses at speed, deck roughness, steps at expansion joints and the bounce of the vehicle suspension make the bridge respond more than when the same vehicle crawls across. Design codes cover this with a fixed dynamic load allowance; AASHTO adds 33% to the static live-load effects of the design vehicle, and the TRB primer on bridge load testing notes that this value is often conservative and is governed mainly by approach roughness and expansion joints. The first purpose of a dynamic load test is to measure this bridge's actual amplification from the ratio of responses to the same test truck at crawl speed and at various speeds. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Dynamic amplification factor” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「車速越快，橋梁的動力放大一定越大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The faster the vehicle, the larger the dynamic amplification must be." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「動力放大係數」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Dynamic amplification factor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 車輛動力效應與衝擊係數
knowledge.titleEn: Vehicle dynamic effects and impact allowance
knowledge.text: 車輛以速度通過橋梁時，橋面不平整、伸縮縫高差與車輛懸吊的彈跳，會使橋梁反應高於同一部車緩慢通過時的靜態反應。設計規範以固定的動力載重容許值涵蓋這個效應，AASHTO 對設計車輛的靜態活載效應增加 33%；TRB 的橋梁載重試驗入門指出這個值常偏保守，主要受引道不平與伸縮縫控制。
knowledge.textEn: When a vehicle crosses at speed, deck roughness, steps at expansion joints and the bounce of the vehicle suspension make the bridge respond more than when the same vehicle crawls across. Design codes cover this with a fixed dynamic load allowance; AASHTO adds 33% to the static live-load effects of the design vehicle, and the TRB primer on bridge load testing notes that this value is often conservative and is governed mainly by approach roughness and expansion joints.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：車速越快，橋梁的動力放大一定越大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The faster the vehicle, the larger the dynamic amplification must be. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「橋梁動態荷重試驗」的「車輛動力效應與衝擊係數：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「城市結構維護班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Vehicle dynamic effects and impact allowance: mechanism and load path” in “Dynamic bridge load testing”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Urban structures maintenance shift” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「車輛動力效應與衝擊係數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Vehicle dynamic effects and impact allowance" is correct?
options: 車速越快，橋梁的動力放大一定越大。
車輛以速度通過橋梁時，橋面不平整、伸縮縫高差與車輛懸吊的彈跳，會使橋梁反應高於同一部車緩慢通過時的靜態反應。
只要垂直頻率避開 2 Hz，人行橋就不會有振動問題。
optionsEn: The faster the vehicle, the larger the dynamic amplification must be.
When a vehicle crosses at speed, deck roughness, steps at expansion joints and the bounce of the vehicle suspension make the bridge respond more than when the same vehicle crawls across.
As long as the vertical frequency avoids 2 Hz, a footbridge will have no vibration problems.
quiz.explanation: 車輛以速度通過橋梁時，橋面不平整、伸縮縫高差與車輛懸吊的彈跳，會使橋梁反應高於同一部車緩慢通過時的靜態反應。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When a vehicle crosses at speed, deck roughness, steps at expansion joints and the bounce of the vehicle suspension make the bridge respond more than when the same vehicle crawls across. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 車輛動力效應與衝擊係數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vehicle dynamic effects and impact allowance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「動力放大係數」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dynamic amplification factor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：DAF = R_dyn/R_static。某主梁下翼板在試驗車以低於 8 km/h 慢速通過時量得 100 με，以 70 km/h 通過時峰值 118 με：DAF = 118/100 = 1.18，即衝擊 18%，低於規範的 33%；若伸縮縫出現 20 mm 高差使峰值升為 140 με，DAF 變為 1.40。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: DAF = R_dyn/R_static. A girder bottom flange reads 100 με when the test truck crawls below 8 km/h and peaks at 118 με at 70 km/h, so DAF = 118/100 = 1.18, an impact of 18%, below the code's 33%; if a 20 mm step at an expansion joint raises the peak to 140 με, DAF becomes 1.40. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個車速至少重複三趟，以同一車道、同一量測點的慢速平均值作為分母；確認動態峰值不是電氣雜訊或單一突波，並記錄當時橋面與伸縮縫狀況，使衝擊值能對應到具體的路面條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat each speed at least three times and use the crawl-speed average for the same lane and gauge as the denominator; confirm that dynamic peaks are not electrical noise or single spikes, and record deck and joint condition at the time so the measured impact is tied to a specific surface condition.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: DAF = R_dyn/R_static。某主梁下翼板在試驗車以低於 8 km/h 慢速通過時量得 100 με，以 70 km/h 通過時峰值 118 με：DAF = 118/100 = 1.18，即衝擊 18%，低於規範的 33%；若伸縮縫出現 20 mm 高差使峰值升為 140 με，DAF 變為 1.40。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: DAF = R_dyn/R_static. A girder bottom flange reads 100 με when the test truck crawls below 8 km/h and peaks at 118 με at 70 km/h, so DAF = 118/100 = 1.18, an impact of 18%, below the code's 33%; if a 20 mm step at an expansion joint raises the peak to 140 με, DAF becomes 1.40. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「車輛動力效應與衝擊係數」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Vehicle dynamic effects and impact allowance", which statement holds?
options: 只要量到最大應變，取樣率高低並不重要。
人行橋只要強度設計通過，就不必做人群振動試驗。
DAF = R_dyn/R_static。
optionsEn: As long as the maximum strain is captured, sampling rate does not matter.
If a footbridge passes its strength design, it needs no crowd vibration test.
DAF = R_dyn/R_static.
quiz.explanation: DAF = R_dyn/R_static。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: DAF = R_dyn/R_static. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 車輛動力效應與衝擊係數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vehicle dynamic effects and impact allowance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「動力放大係數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dynamic amplification factor” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每個車速至少重複三趟，以同一車道、同一量測點的慢速平均值作為分母；確認動態峰值不是電氣雜訊或單一突波，並記錄當時橋面與伸縮縫狀況，使衝擊值能對應到具體的路面條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat each speed at least three times and use the crawl-speed average for the same lane and gauge as the denominator; confirm that dynamic peaks are not electrical noise or single spikes, and record deck and joint condition at the time so the measured impact is tied to a specific surface condition. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：試驗報告要寫明實測動力放大適用的路面與伸縮縫條件，並規定伸縮縫更換、路面重鋪或出現明顯高差時須重新評估；以實測值取代規範值須由評等工程師簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The test report must state the surface and joint conditions under which the measured amplification applies, and require reassessment after joint replacement, resurfacing or a visible step; replacing the code value with a measured one needs the rating engineer's signature.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只在路面剛重鋪後做試驗，量到的動力放大偏低；數年後伸縮縫磨損、引道沉陷，實際衝擊可能遠超過試驗值，以此低值放寬評等的橋就失去了原本由規範值提供的保守度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only just after resurfacing measures low amplification; years later, with worn joints and settled approaches, actual impact can far exceed the test value, and a bridge whose rating was relaxed on that low value has lost the margin the code value provided. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每個車速至少重複三趟，以同一車道、同一量測點的慢速平均值作為分母；確認動態峰值不是電氣雜訊或單一突波，並記錄當時橋面與伸縮縫狀況，使衝擊值能對應到具體的路面條件。
knowledge.textEn: Repeat each speed at least three times and use the crawl-speed average for the same lane and gauge as the denominator; confirm that dynamic peaks are not electrical noise or single spikes, and record deck and joint condition at the time so the measured impact is tied to a specific surface condition.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 試驗報告要寫明實測動力放大適用的路面與伸縮縫條件，並規定伸縮縫更換、路面重鋪或出現明顯高差時須重新評估；以實測值取代規範值須由評等工程師簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The test report must state the surface and joint conditions under which the measured amplification applies, and require reassessment after joint replacement, resurfacing or a visible step; replacing the code value with a measured one needs the rating engineer's signature.

quiz.question: 要驗證「車輛動力效應與衝擊係數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Vehicle dynamic effects and impact allowance"?
options: 每個車速至少重複三趟，以同一車道、同一量測點的慢速平均值作為分母。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
實測應變比計算低，就可以按比例直接提高橋梁的容許載重。
optionsEn: Repeat each speed at least three times and use the crawl-speed average for the same lane and gauge as the denominator.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If measured strain is lower than calculated, the permitted load can be raised in direct proportion.
quiz.explanation: 每個車速至少重複三趟，以同一車道、同一量測點的慢速平均值作為分母；確認動態峰值不是電氣雜訊或單一突波，並記錄當時橋面與伸縮縫狀況，使衝擊值能對應到具體的路面條件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeat each speed at least three times and use the crawl-speed average for the same lane and gauge as the denominator; confirm that dynamic peaks are not electrical noise or single spikes, and record deck and joint condition at the time so the measured impact is tied to a specific surface condition. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 車輛動力效應與衝擊係數：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Vehicle dynamic effects and impact allowance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「動力放大係數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dynamic amplification factor” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只在路面剛重鋪後做試驗，量到的動力放大偏低；數年後伸縮縫磨損、引道沉陷，實際衝擊可能遠超過試驗值，以此低值放寬評等的橋就失去了原本由規範值提供的保守度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only just after resurfacing measures low amplification; years later, with worn joints and settled approaches, actual impact can far exceed the test value, and a bridge whose rating was relaxed on that low value has lost the margin the code value provided. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：動態荷重試驗的第一個目的，就是用同一部試驗車在慢速與不同車速下的反應比值，量出這座橋實際的動力放大。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The first purpose of a dynamic load test is to measure this bridge's actual amplification from the ratio of responses to the same test truck at crawl speed and at various speeds.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「車速越快，橋梁的動力放大一定越大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The faster the vehicle, the larger the dynamic amplification must be." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只在路面剛重鋪後做試驗，量到的動力放大偏低；數年後伸縮縫磨損、引道沉陷，實際衝擊可能遠超過試驗值，以此低值放寬評等的橋就失去了原本由規範值提供的保守度。
knowledge.textEn: Testing only just after resurfacing measures low amplification; years later, with worn joints and settled approaches, actual impact can far exceed the test value, and a bridge whose rating was relaxed on that low value has lost the margin the code value provided.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「車輛動力效應與衝擊係數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Vehicle dynamic effects and impact allowance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只在路面剛重鋪後做試驗，量到的動力放大偏低；數年後伸縮縫磨損、引道沉陷，實際衝擊可能遠超過試驗值，以此低值放寬評等的橋就失去了原本由規範值提供的保守度。
只要垂直頻率避開 2 Hz，人行橋就不會有振動問題。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Testing only just after resurfacing measures low amplification.
As long as the vertical frequency avoids 2 Hz, a footbridge will have no vibration problems.
quiz.explanation: 若只在路面剛重鋪後做試驗，量到的動力放大偏低；數年後伸縮縫磨損、引道沉陷，實際衝擊可能遠超過試驗值，以此低值放寬評等的橋就失去了原本由規範值提供的保守度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing only just after resurfacing measures low amplification; years later, with worn joints and settled approaches, actual impact can far exceed the test value, and a bridge whose rating was relaxed on that low value has lost the margin the code value provided. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 人群誘發振動與同步效應：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Crowd-induced vibration and lock-in: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「側向步頻與人群同步」如何影響橋梁動態荷重試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lateral footfall and crowd lock-in” governs force, deformation or durability in “Dynamic bridge load testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 行人步行的垂直力頻率約 2 Hz，左右腳交替產生的側向力頻率只有一半，約 1 Hz。若橋的側向振態落在這個範圍且阻尼很低，橋面輕微搖晃會讓行人不自覺調整步伐去配合，側向力因而同步放大，形成正回饋。倫敦千禧橋在 2000 年 6 月 10 日開放，兩天後就因側向振動封閉；這種同步側向激振不會隨人數平滑增加，而是在人數超過臨界值時突然出現，因此一般的單人或小群試驗看不到。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「側向步頻與人群同步」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Walking produces vertical forces at about 2 Hz, while the alternating left and right steps produce lateral forces at half that, about 1 Hz. If a bridge has a lightly damped lateral mode in this range, slight sway makes pedestrians unconsciously adjust their gait to match it, so their lateral forces synchronise and grow in positive feedback. London's Millennium Bridge opened on 10 June 2000 and closed two days later because of lateral vibration; this synchronous lateral excitation does not grow smoothly with crowd size but appears suddenly once the number of people passes a critical value, so tests with one walker or a small group do not reveal it. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lateral footfall and crowd lock-in” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：臨界人數 N_L = 8π·ζ·f·M/k，k 為每人側向力與橋面速度的比例係數。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Critical number of pedestrians N_L = 8π·ζ·f·M/k, where k relates each person's lateral force to deck velocity.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要垂直頻率避開 2 Hz，人行橋就不會有振動問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the vertical frequency avoids 2 Hz, a footbridge will have no vibration problems." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「側向步頻與人群同步」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lateral footfall and crowd lock-in”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 人群誘發振動與同步效應
knowledge.text: 行人步行的垂直力頻率約 2 Hz，左右腳交替產生的側向力頻率只有一半，約 1 Hz。若橋的側向振態落在這個範圍且阻尼很低，橋面輕微搖晃會讓行人不自覺調整步伐去配合，側向力因而同步放大，形成正回饋。
knowledge.textEn: Walking produces vertical forces at about 2 Hz, while the alternating left and right steps produce lateral forces at half that, about 1 Hz. If a bridge has a lightly damped lateral mode in this range, slight sway makes pedestrians unconsciously adjust their gait to match it, so their lateral forces synchronise and grow in positive feedback.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要垂直頻率避開 2 Hz，人行橋就不會有振動問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the vertical frequency avoids 2 Hz, a footbridge will have no vibration problems. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「人群誘發振動與同步效應」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Crowd-induced vibration and lock-in" is correct?
options: 只要垂直頻率避開 2 Hz，人行橋就不會有振動問題。
載重試驗用的車越重，得到的結論就越可靠。
行人步行的垂直力頻率約 2 Hz，左右腳交替產生的側向力頻率只有一半，約 1 Hz。
optionsEn: As long as the vertical frequency avoids 2 Hz, a footbridge will have no vibration problems.
The heavier the test vehicle, the more reliable the conclusions.
Walking produces vertical forces at about 2 Hz, while the alternating left and right steps produce lateral forces at half that, about 1 Hz.
quiz.explanation: 行人步行的垂直力頻率約 2 Hz，左右腳交替產生的側向力頻率只有一半，約 1 Hz。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Walking produces vertical forces at about 2 Hz, while the alternating left and right steps produce lateral forces at half that, about 1 Hz. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 人群誘發振動與同步效應：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crowd-induced vibration and lock-in: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「側向步頻與人群同步」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lateral footfall and crowd lock-in” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：臨界人數 N_L = 8π·ζ·f·M/k，k 為每人側向力與橋面速度的比例係數。取 ζ = 0.7%、f = 1.0 Hz、模態質量 M = 130,000 kg、k = 300 N·s/m：N_L = 8π×0.007×1.0×130,000/300 ≈ 76 人；阻尼提高到 15% 時 N_L ≈ 1,630 人。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Critical number of pedestrians N_L = 8π·ζ·f·M/k, where k relates each person's lateral force to deck velocity. With ζ = 0.7%, f = 1.0 Hz, modal mass M = 130,000 kg and k = 300 N·s/m, N_L = 8π×0.007×1.0×130,000/300 ≈ 76 people; raising damping to 15% gives N_L ≈ 1,630 people. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以逐步增加人數的群眾步行試驗，同步量測橋面側向加速度與橋上人數，找出加速度突然非線性增加時的人數，並與 N_L 估計比較；試驗須設定中止準則，例如側向加速度超過預定值即停止放行並疏散。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run walking tests with stepwise increases in crowd size while measuring lateral deck acceleration and the number on the bridge, find the count at which acceleration suddenly grows nonlinearly and compare it with the N_L estimate; set a stop criterion, for example halting entry and clearing the deck once lateral acceleration exceeds a preset value.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 臨界人數 N_L = 8π·ζ·f·M/k，k 為每人側向力與橋面速度的比例係數。取 ζ = 0.7%、f = 1.0 Hz、模態質量 M = 130,000 kg、k = 300 N·s/m：N_L = 8π×0.007×1.0×130,000/300 ≈ 76 人；阻尼提高到 15% 時 N_L ≈ 1,630 人。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Critical number of pedestrians N_L = 8π·ζ·f·M/k, where k relates each person's lateral force to deck velocity. With ζ = 0.7%, f = 1.0 Hz, modal mass M = 130,000 kg and k = 300 N·s/m, N_L = 8π×0.007×1.0×130,000/300 ≈ 76 people; raising damping to 15% gives N_L ≈ 1,630 people. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「人群誘發振動與同步效應」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Crowd-induced vibration and lock-in", which statement holds?
options: 臨界人數 N_L = 8π·ζ·f·M/k，k 為每人側向力與橋面速度的比例係數。
動態試驗只要讓卡車以最高速通過一次就夠了。
實測頻率比模型高，就代表橋梁沒有任何問題。
optionsEn: Critical number of pedestrians N_L = 8π·ζ·f·M/k, where k relates each person's lateral force to deck velocity.
A dynamic test only needs one pass of the truck at top speed.
A measured frequency higher than the model means the bridge has no problems.
quiz.explanation: 臨界人數 N_L = 8π·ζ·f·M/k，k 為每人側向力與橋面速度的比例係數。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Critical number of pedestrians N_L = 8π·ζ·f·M/k, where k relates each person's lateral force to deck velocity. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 人群誘發振動與同步效應：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crowd-induced vibration and lock-in: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「側向步頻與人群同步」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lateral footfall and crowd lock-in” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以逐步增加人數的群眾步行試驗，同步量測橋面側向加速度與橋上人數，找出加速度突然非線性增加時的人數，並與 N_L 估計比較；試驗須設定中止準則，例如側向加速度超過預定值即停止放行並疏散。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run walking tests with stepwise increases in crowd size while measuring lateral deck acceleration and the number on the bridge, find the count at which acceleration suddenly grows nonlinearly and compare it with the N_L estimate; set a stop criterion, for example halting entry and clearing the deck once lateral acceleration exceeds a preset value. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：人行橋設計須同時檢查垂直與側向振態；側向頻率低於約 1.3 Hz 且質量輕時，要以人群密度情境評估同步風險，並預留加裝阻尼器的空間與連接點，開放前由設計者主持人群試驗並簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check both vertical and lateral modes in footbridge design; where a light deck has lateral frequencies below about 1.3 Hz, assess lock-in risk under crowd-density scenarios and reserve space and connections for dampers, with a crowd test led and signed off by the designer before opening.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：千禧橋開幕日約有 90,000 人通過、同時最多約 2,000 人在橋上，側向擺動最大約 70 mm，行人需要扶著欄杆行走；橋梁開放兩天即封閉，改造工程自 2001 年 5 月持續到 2002 年 1 月。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: On the Millennium Bridge's opening day about 90,000 people crossed with up to about 2,000 on the deck at once; lateral sway reached about 70 mm and walkers had to hold the handrails. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以逐步增加人數的群眾步行試驗，同步量測橋面側向加速度與橋上人數，找出加速度突然非線性增加時的人數，並與 N_L 估計比較；試驗須設定中止準則，例如側向加速度超過預定值即停止放行並疏散。
knowledge.textEn: Run walking tests with stepwise increases in crowd size while measuring lateral deck acceleration and the number on the bridge, find the count at which acceleration suddenly grows nonlinearly and compare it with the N_L estimate; set a stop criterion, for example halting entry and clearing the deck once lateral acceleration exceeds a preset value.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 人行橋設計須同時檢查垂直與側向振態；側向頻率低於約 1.3 Hz 且質量輕時，要以人群密度情境評估同步風險，並預留加裝阻尼器的空間與連接點，開放前由設計者主持人群試驗並簽認。
knowledge.textEn: Check both vertical and lateral modes in footbridge design; where a light deck has lateral frequencies below about 1.3 Hz, assess lock-in risk under crowd-density scenarios and reserve space and connections for dampers, with a crowd test led and signed off by the designer before opening.

quiz.question: 要驗證「人群誘發振動與同步效應」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Crowd-induced vibration and lock-in"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以逐步增加人數的群眾步行試驗，同步量測橋面側向加速度與橋上人數，找出加速度突然非線性增加時的人數，並與 N_L 估計比較。
加大構件斷面一定是解決人行橋振動最有效的方法。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Run walking tests with stepwise increases in crowd size while measuring lateral deck acceleration and the number on the bridge, find the count at which acceleration suddenly grows nonlinearly and compare it with the N_L estimate.
Enlarging member sections is always the most effective cure for footbridge vibration.
quiz.explanation: 以逐步增加人數的群眾步行試驗，同步量測橋面側向加速度與橋上人數，找出加速度突然非線性增加時的人數，並與 N_L 估計比較；試驗須設定中止準則，例如側向加速度超過預定值即停止放行並疏散。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run walking tests with stepwise increases in crowd size while measuring lateral deck acceleration and the number on the bridge, find the count at which acceleration suddenly grows nonlinearly and compare it with the N_L estimate; set a stop criterion, for example halting entry and clearing the deck once lateral acceleration exceeds a preset value. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.titleEn: Crowd-induced vibration and lock-in: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「側向步頻與人群同步」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lateral footfall and crowd lock-in” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: London's Millennium Bridge opened on 10 June 2000 and closed two days later because of lateral vibration; this synchronous lateral excitation does not grow smoothly with crowd size but appears suddenly once the number of people passes a critical value, so tests with one walker or a small group do not reveal it.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要垂直頻率避開 2 Hz，人行橋就不會有振動問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as the vertical frequency avoids 2 Hz, a footbridge will have no vibration problems." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 千禧橋開幕日約有 90,000 人通過、同時最多約 2,000 人在橋上，側向擺動最大約 70 mm，行人需要扶著欄杆行走；橋梁開放兩天即封閉，改造工程自 2001 年 5 月持續到 2002 年 1 月。
knowledge.textEn: On the Millennium Bridge's opening day about 90,000 people crossed with up to about 2,000 on the deck at once; lateral sway reached about 70 mm and walkers had to hold the handrails. The bridge closed after two days, and the retrofit ran from May 2001 to January 2002.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「人群誘發振動與同步效應」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Crowd-induced vibration and lock-in" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
載重試驗用的車越重，得到的結論就越可靠。
千禧橋開幕日約有 90,000 人通過、同時最多約 2,000 人在橋上，側向擺動最大約 70 mm，行人需要扶著欄杆行走。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The heavier the test vehicle, the more reliable the conclusions.
On the Millennium Bridge's opening day about 90,000 people crossed with up to about 2,000 on the deck at once.
quiz.explanation: 千禧橋開幕日約有 90,000 人通過、同時最多約 2,000 人在橋上，側向擺動最大約 70 mm，行人需要扶著欄杆行走；橋梁開放兩天即封閉，改造工程自 2001 年 5 月持續到 2002 年 1 月。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: On the Millennium Bridge's opening day about 90,000 people crossed with up to about 2,000 on the deck at once; lateral sway reached about 70 mm and walkers had to hold the handrails. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
